out_type.description: (Optional) The specified non-quantized numeric output type of the operation. Defaults to `tf.int32`. (Note: there is an experimental flag, `tf_shape_default_int64` that changes the default to `tf.int64`. This is an unsupported, experimental setting that causes known breakages.)

output.description: A `Tensor` of type `out_type`. Defaults to `tf.int32`. @compatibility(numpy) Equivalent to np.size() @end_compatibility
